professionalSummary.text: Experienced backend engineer with a proven track record of deploying and maintaining the trade settlement service in production, managing on-call responsibilities, and ensuring smooth cut‑off operations.
professionalSummary.witness: Deployed sixty‑one changes to the trade settlement service in production through the deployment pipeline between 2022 and 2025, each under a change ticket in my name and a deployment record in the pipeline.

experienceHighlights.text: Deployed 61 production changes via the deployment pipeline, each documented with a change ticket and pipeline record.
experienceHighlights.witness: Deployed sixty‑one changes to the trade settlement service in production through the deployment pipeline between 2022 and 2025, each under a change ticket in my name and a deployment record in the pipeline.

experienceHighlights.text: Held on‑call rota for the entire period, resolving incidents including a March 2024 matching backlog cleared 11 minutes before cut‑off.
experienceHighlights.witness: Held a place on the settlement on‑call rota for the whole period and handled the production incidents that fell on my shifts, including the matching backlog of March 2024 that was cleared eleven minutes before the depository cut‑off; the incident records are in the settlement incident log.

experienceHighlights.text: Monitored live settlement queue on cut‑off days, logging interventions and ownership in the cut‑off log.
experienceHighlights.witness: Watched the live settlement queue on cut‑off days from the operations bridge, recording in the cut‑off log which interventions were mine and which belonged to the operations desk.

experienceHighlights.text: Developed and tested matching changes against the depository test window before deployment, attaching results to change tickets.
experienceHighlights.witness: Developed and tested each matching change against the depository's test window before deployment, with the test window results attached to the change ticket.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented service limitations and hand‑over conditions in change ticket closure notes and the settlement runbook.
experienceHighlights.witness: Documented the service's known limitations and the hand‑over conditions for each change in the change ticket's closure note and in the settlement runbook.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided work samples including change tickets, deployment records, incident log for March 2024 backlog, and cut‑off log.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the change tickets and deployment records for the last quarter, the settlement incident log record for the March 2024 backlog and the cut‑off log for the same month.

skills.text: Deployment pipeline management, on‑call incident handling, cut‑off queue monitoring, test‑window integration, documentation and runbook maintenance.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s direct experience with deployment, on‑call duties, cut‑off monitoring, test‑window testing, and documentation for the trade settlement service; no other claims are made.

decisionBoundary.statement: The evidence supports all role requirements; human review recommended to confirm fit.

evidence.text: Deployed sixty‑one changes to the trade settlement service in production through the deployment pipeline between 2022 and 2025, each under a change ticket in my name and a deployment record in the pipeline.

Held a place on the settlement on‑call rota for the whole period and handled the production incidents that fell on my shifts, including the matching backlog of March 2024 that was cleared eleven minutes before the depository cut‑off; the incident records are in the settlement incident log.
Watched the live settlement queue on cut‑off days from the operations bridge, recording in the cut‑off log which interventions were mine and which belonged to the operations desk.
Developed and tested each matching change against the depository's test window before deployment, with the test window results attached to the change ticket.
Documented the service's known limitations and the hand‑over conditions for each change in the change ticket's closure note and in the settlement runbook.
